_doc: Bot cycle 47 (M0): derived official-legal compliance projections. A projection is DERIVED from a deck's one canonical project list by the substitutions below; it is labeled 'derived compliance projection (not canonical)', never canonical, never in an approval state, and never competes for authority (Cory constraint 1). Read by scripts/build_grixis.py (deck page section), scripts/grixis_refine.py (export file) and scripts/grixis_authority.py (registry + checks).
label: derived compliance projection (not canonical)

substitutions.why: Trade Secrets is banned in Commander. Wizard Class was logged as a close alternative ("hand-size support") in the source's approval dossier: "You have no maximum hand size", and level 2 draws two cards, serving Cecily's eleven-card hand. This was the Bot cycle 16 import correction; since Bot cycle 47 it lives only in this projection.

Yawgmoth's Bargain is banned in Commander. Flame of Anor ("Target player draws two cards" as one mode; two modes if you control a Wizard, and Cecily is a Human Wizard) is another alternative from the source dossier. Bot cycle 16 import correction; since Bot cycle 47 projection only.

Cecily__Bjorna__Lutri.drop_companion_why: Commander bans Lutri, the Spellchaser only as a companion (Wizards banned & restricted list); Lutri stays legal in the 99. The projection plays without a companion.
